verses.translation: A Psalm of instruction for Asaph. Wherefore hast thou rejected us, O God, for ever? wherefore is thy wrath kindled against the sheep of thy pasture?

translations.ron: Pentru ce m-ai lepădat, Dumnezeule, până în sfârşit? Aprinsu-s-a inima Ta peste oile păşunii Tale.
translations.grk: Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ. Ἱνατί ἀπόσω ὁ Θεὸς εἰς τέλος; ὠργίσθη ὁ θυμός σου ἐπὶ πρόβατα νομῆς σου;

verses.translation: Remember thy congregation which thou hast purchased from the beginning; thou didst ransom the rod of thine inheritance; this mount Sion wherein thou hast dwelt.

translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte de poporul Tău, pe care l-ai câştigat de la început.
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἐλυτρώσω ῥάβδον κληρονομίας σου· ὄρος Σιὼν τοῦτο ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ.

verses.translation: Lift up thine hands against their pride continually; because of all that the enemy has done wickedly in thy holy places.

translations.ron: Izbăvit-ai toiagul moştenirii Tale, muntele Sionului, acesta în care ai locuit.
translations.grk: Ἔπαρον τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐπὶ τὰς ὑπερηφανίας αὐτῶν εἰς τέλος· ὅσα ἐπονηρεύσατο ὁ ἐχθρὸς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις σου.

verses.translation: And they that hate thee have boasted in the midst of thy feast; they have set up their standards for signs,

translations.ron: Ridică mâinile Tale împotriva mândriilor lor, până la sfârşit, că rău a făcut vrăjmaşul în locul cel sfânt al Tău.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνεκαυχήσαντο οἱ μισοῦντές σε ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ἑορτῆς σου·

verses.translation: ignorantly as it were in the entrance above;

translations.ron: Şi s-au fălit cei ce Te urăsc pe Tine în mijlocul locului de prăznuire al Tău, pus-au semnele lor drept semne;
translations.grk: ἔθεντο τὰ σημεῖα αὐτῶν σημεῖα, καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν, ὡς εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον ὑπεράνω· ὡς ἐν δρυμῷ ξύλων ἀξίναις ἐξέκοψαν

verses.translation: they cut down its doors at once with axes as in a wood of trees; they have broken it down with hatchet and stone cutter.

translations.ron: Sfărâmat-au intrarea cea de deasupra.
translations.grk: τὰς θύρας αὐτῆς ἐπιτοαυτὸ, ἐν πελέκει καὶ λαξευτηρίῳ κατέῤῥαξαν αὐτήν.

verses.translation: They have burnt thy sanctuary with fire to the ground; they have profaned the habitation of thy name.

translations.ron: Ca în codru cu topoarele au tăiat uşile locaşului Tău, cu topoare şi ciocane l-au sfărâmat.
translations.grk: Ἐνεπύρισαν ἐν πυρὶ τὸ ἁγιαστήριόν σου εἰς τὴν γῆν, ἐβεβήλωσαν τὸ σκήνωμα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου.

verses.translation: They have said in their heart, even all their kindred together, Come, let us abolish the feasts of the Lord from the earth.

translations.ron: Ars-au cu foc locaşul cel sfânt al Tău, până la pământ; spurcat-au locul numelui Tău.
translations.grk: Εἶπαν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν, ἡ συγγένεια αὐτῶν ἐπιτοαυτὸ, δεῦτε, καταπαύσωμεν τὰς ἑορτὰς Κυρίου ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς.

verses.translation: We have not seen our signs; there is no longer a prophet; and God will not know us any more.

translations.ron: Zis-au în inima lor împreună cu neamul lor: "Veniţi să ardem toate locurile de prăznuire ale lui Dumnezeu de pe pământ".
translations.grk: Τὰ σημεῖα ἡμῶν οὐκ εἴδομεν, οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι προφήτης, καὶ ἡμᾶς οὐ γνώσεται ἔτι.

verses.translation: How long, O God, shall the enemy reproach? shall the enemy provoke thy name for ever?

translations.ron: Semnele noastre nu le-am văzut; nu mai este profet şi pe noi nu ne va mai cunoaşte.
translations.grk: Ἕως πότε ὁ Θεὸς, ὀνειδιεῖ ὁ ἐχθρὸς, παροξυνεῖ ὁ ὑπεναντίος τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τέλος;

verses.translation: Wherefore turnest thou away thine hand, and thy right hand from the midst of thy bosom for ever?

translations.ron: Până când, Dumnezeule, Te va ocărî vrăjmaşul, până când va huli potrivnicul numele Tău, până în sfârşit?
translations.grk: Ἱνατί ἀποστρέφεις τὴν χεῖρά σου, καὶ τὴν δεξιάν σου ἐκ μέσου τοῦ κόλπου σου εἰς τέλος;

verses.translation: But God is our King of old; he has wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.

translations.ron: Pentru ce întorci mâna Ta şi dreapta Ta din sânul Tău, până în sfârşit?
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰῶνος, εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς.

verses.translation: Thou didst establish the sea, in thy might, thou didst break to pieces the heads of the dragons in the water.

translations.ron: Dar Dumnezeu, Împăratul nostru înainte de veac, a făcut mântuire în mijlocul pământului.
translations.grk: Σὺ ἐκραταίωσας ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου τὴν θάλασσαν, σὺ συνέτριψας τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν δρακόντων ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος. Σὺ συνέτριψας τὰς κεφαλὰς τοῦ δράκοντος,

verses.translation: Thou didst break to pieces the heads of the dragon; thou didst give him for meat to the Ethiopian nations.

translations.ron: Tu ai despărţit, cu puterea Ta, marea; Tu ai zdrobit capetele balaurilor din apă;
translations.grk: ἔδωκας αὐτὸν βρῶμα λαοῖς τοῖς Αἰθίοψι.

verses.translation: Thou didst cleave fountains and torrents; thou driedst up mighty rivers.

translations.ron: Tu ai sfărâmat capul balaurului; datu-l-ai pe el mâncare popoarelor pustiului.
translations.grk: Σὺ διέῤῥηξας πηγὰς καὶ χειμάῤῥους, σὺ ἐξήρανας ποταμοὺς ἠθάμ.

verses.translation: The day is thine, and the night is thine; thou hast prepared the sun and the moon.

translations.ron: Tu ai deschis izvoare şi pâraie; Tu ai secat râurile Itanului.
translations.grk: Σή ἐστιν ἡ ἡμέρα, καὶ σή ἐστιν ἡ νὺξ, σὺ κατηρτίσω ἥλιον καὶ σελήνην.

verses.translation: Thou hast made all the borders of the earth; thou hast made summer and spring.

translations.ron: A Ta este ziua şi a Ta este noaptea. Tu ai întocmit lumina şi soarele.
translations.grk: Σὺ ἐποίησας πάντα τὰ ὅρια τῆς γῆς, θέρος καὶ ἔαρ σὺ ἐποίησας.

verses.translation: Remember this thy creation: an enemy has reproached the Lord, and a foolish people has provoked thy name.

translations.ron: Tu ai făcut toate marginile pământului; vara şi primăvara Tu le-ai zidit.
translations.grk: Μνήσθητι ταύτης τῆς κτίσεώς σου· ἐχθρὸς ὠνείδισε τὸν Κύριον, καὶ λαὸς ἄφρων παρώξυνε τὸ ὄνομά σου.

verses.translation: Deliver not to the wild beasts a soul that gives praise to thee: forget not for ever the souls of thy poor.

translations.ron: Adu-Ţi aminte de aceasta: Vrăjmaşul a ocărât pe Domnul şi poporul cel fără de minte a hulit numele Tău.
translations.grk: Μὴ παραδῷς τοῖς θηρίοις ψυχὴν ἐξομολογουμένην σοι, τῶν ψυχῶν τῶν πενήτων σου μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ εἰς τέλος.

verses.translation: Look upon thy covenant: for the dark places of the earth are filled with the habitations of iniquity.

translations.ron: Să nu dai fiarelor sufletul ce Te laudă pe Tine; sufletele săracilor Tăi să nu le uiţi până în sfârşit.
translations.grk: Ἐπίβλεψον εἰς τὴν διαθήκην σου, ὅτι ἐπληρωθήσαν οἱ ἐσκοτωμένοι τῆς γῆς οἴκων ἀνομιῶν.

verses.translation: Let not the afflicted and shamed one be rejected: the poor and needy shall praise thy name.

translations.ron: Caută spre legământul Tău, că s-au umplut ascunzişurile pământului de locuinţele fărădelegilor.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἀποστραφήτω τεταπεινωμένος καὶ κατῃσχυμμένος, πτωχὸς καὶ πένης αἰνέσουσι τὸ ὄνομά σου.

verses.translation: Arise, O God, plead thy cause: remember thy reproaches that come from the foolish one all the day.

translations.ron: Să nu se întoarcă ruşinat cel umilit; săracul şi sărmanul şă laude numele Tău.
translations.grk: Ἀνάστα ὁ Θεὸς, δίκασον τὴν δίκην σου, μνήσθητι τῶν ὀνειδισμῶν σου τῶν ὑπὸ ἄφρονος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.

verses.translation: Forget not the voice of thy suppliants: let the pride of them that hate thee continually ascend before thee.

translations.ron: Scoală-Te, Dumnezeule, apără pricina Ta; adu-Ţi aminte de ocara de fiecare zi, cu care Te necinsteşte cel fără de minte.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῆς φωνῆς τῶν ἱκετῶν σου, ἡ ὑπερηφανία τῶν μισούντων σε ἀναβαίη διαπαντὸς πρὸς σέ.
